info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' .. seke varzet , snehe tu varzate ' ( Slo. 176) iti devaH .

examples: 'vizaye vAsavastasya samyageva pravarzati' (BA॰anu॰2.14). praSabdena nArTaH. samyakCabdena prakarzasyoktatvAt.
'parjanya iva DarmAnte vfzwyA sAdridrumAM mahIm. AcAryaputrastAM senAM bARavfzwyA vyavIvfzat' (BA0 karRa0 20.32).. vyavIvfzat=aByavIvfzat. bARavarzeRABiziktavAn ityarTaH.
'samA dvAdaSa parjanyastadrAzwraM nABivarzati' (BA0 sO0 15.23). nABivarzati nABiziYcati.
'taTABivarzetsvaM rAzwraM kAmErindravrataM caran' (manu0 9.304). rAzwre kAmyAnAM vfzwiM kuryAdityarTaH.
'kzurAgrESca vAnarAn paryavarzata' (rA0 6.75.47). paryavarzata aByavarzata, tatra kzurAgravarzamakarot.
